goal: Remove fake/inferred baselines; calibration is explicit and accuracy-gated. Redraw Monstera to look recognizably like the reference.

leaves.title: PostureEngine: explicit calibration only + stability check
leaves.goal: Engine only calibrates after recalibrate(); 4-degree spread gate rejects unstable holds; no silent auto-calibration on start().

leaves.title: CalibrateView: no fake baseline, retry on failure, skip=nil
leaves.goal: Timeout/unstable → failure state with Try Again. No ?? currentPitch fallback. Skip passes nil (no fake baseline).

leaves.title: NowView: 'Set baseline' CTA when no baseline
leaves.goal: When settings.baselinePitch == nil, show 'Set your baseline' + CTA opening CalibrateView sheet, not 'Getting your baseline…'.

leaves.title: Monstera: fuller pot, split leaves, veins, dark outlines
leaves.goal: Rewrite Monstera Canvas to match reference: terracotta pot with rim+outline, 2 stems, 5-6 split leaves with notched edges + central veins.

leaves.title: Tests: explicit calibration, stable accept, unstable reject, no auto-cal
leaves.goal: 3-4 Swift Testing cases with FakeMotionSource covering the new engine behavior.
